description: This file defines the EmployeeEmergencyContactsController class within the OrangeHRM framework, responsible for handling employee emergency contact views and permissions within the PIM module. It manages pre-render setup including component creation and permission checks based on request attributes.

classes.name: EmployeeEmergencyContactsController
classes.description: Controller class managing the employee emergency contacts view and permissions in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the component with employee emergency contact details and sets permissions based on the employee number received from the request.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups used for permission verification, specifically for emergency contact capabilities.
